name: Transit Swap, Ethereum leg: Yoink's bot front-ran the attacker's last tx
race_type_reason: Yoink's tx (index 24) makes the same 21 Transit Swap router calls on the same victims as the attacker's last pending exploit tx (index 43, reverted), with only the recipient changed; it won the block position by a 2-wei higher tip. Scope: only the attacker's last of nine Ethereum txs; the earlier eight landed.
one_liner: Yoink replayed the Transit Swap attacker's last pending exploit tx (21/21 router calls, recipient swapped) one tier ahead at index 24 of block 15655281 and swapped 5,974.5 UNI to 29.3065 WETH; the attacker's tx reverted. Yoink returned 26.505 ETH 11 months later.

mempool_note: In-block evidence only: October 2022 is before the mempool-dumpster archive (starts 2023-08-07), and the block has no MEV-Boost bid history. Yoink's tx looks like an ordinary public tx (type 2, no coinbase payment); whether it saw the attacker's tx pending or inferred the calls from the earlier eight is not shown. Yoink did not front-run the attacker's earlier eight txs.

trigger.note: No mempool first-seen exists (pre-archive). The tx Yoink's calls mirror is the attacker's last tx 0x6f7d546a (index 43 of the same block), the only one of the attacker's nine Ethereum txs that Yoink front-ran.

attacker_block_note: Attacker's last exploit tx 0x6f7d546a is in the same block, index 43 (tip 3.0 gwei), and reverted.

auction.auction_note: No MEV-Boost bid history for this block (no relay we can query reports it: vanilla or privately built block, fee recipient 0x4675c7e5, empty extraData). Ordering is explained by priority fee alone: Yoink's 3.000000002 gwei tip (+2 wei over the attacker's 3.0 gwei) puts it ahead of the 3.0-gwei tier, which holds the attacker's tx at index 43.

loot.gross_loot_method: WETH out of the UNI swap in the Yoink tx (callTracer): 5,974.521 UNI taken from 21 router approvals, swapped via a Uniswap pool to 29.3065 WETH, unwrapped to ETH

captured_native.desc: UNI taken by 21 router calls (recipient = Yoink contract 0x6c6b87d4), sold for WETH inside the tx

loot.loot_note: bot_net_eth = 29.306499 ETH - 0.009277 ETH gas (1,023,336 gas x 9.065325223 gwei, incl. 0.003070 ETH tip); there was no coinbase payment. This covers tx 0x9f43b61d only: Yoink's separate sweep in block 15655307 (0.869 WETH, 0.714 ETH to the builder) is excluded, and Yoink's offer of '90% of the profits (26.505 ETH)' implies a total profit of about 29.45 ETH that includes it. No USD figure is saved for 2022-10-01.

fate.returned_desc: Transit messaged Yoink on-chain on 2022-10-04, 10-06 and 10-07. Yoink replied on-chain on 2022-10-23 (tx 0x57a98ef2, block 15807716): 'My bot frontran the real attacker. How about I return 90% of the profits (26.505 Eth) and keep 10% as a bounty?'. Transit accepted on 2023-05-22 (tx 0x3edd298a, block 17313155). Yoink sent exactly 26.505 ETH to 0xd989f7b4 on 2023-09-06T14:24:35Z (tx 0x074acda8, block 18077979), about 11 months after the offer. Separately, the attacker's recipient address 0x75f2aba6 returned 3,180 ETH to Transit's deployer at block 15658229 (about 2022-10-02, tx 0x2e9d1f3e); that is not Yoink's return.
fate.bounty_desc: 10% bounty Yoink proposed to keep and Transit accepted; derived from the message (26.505 ETH = 90% of profits, so about 2.945 ETH), not an on-chain transfer

returned_txs.note: Yoink EOA 0xfde0d157 -> Transit funds receiver 0xd989f7b4, exactly 26.505 ETH

fate.public_statement: On-chain message from Yoink's EOA to Transit's receiver (tx 0x57a98ef2, 2022-10-23): Sorry, just saw your message. My bot frontran the real attacker. How about I return 90% of the profits (26.505 Eth) and keep 10% as a bounty? If that's acceptable, let me know, otherwise you can reach out to me here: [email redacted]
fate.return_status_rule: returned = everything went back to the victim side except a bounty the victim agreed to or offered; partial = some came back, otherwise; none = known zero within the documented search window; unknown = unresolved

rawref_gaps.why: no saved ETH/UNI price for 2022-10-01; not converted (incident.json's ~$38K is a rough estimate)
dates of the three Transit messages (10-04/06/07) are from incident.json, not re-opened

discrepancies: initial incident notes phrased the offer as '90% of 26.505 ETH'; the on-chain message says 26.505 ETH IS the 90% share ('return 90% of the profits (26.505 Eth) and keep 10%'), implying total profits of about 29.45 ETH. Row kept_by_bot_eth is tx-level (gross 29.31 - gas - 26.505), so it differs from the 2.945 ETH bounty.
Yoink's 29.45 ETH profit basis includes a second Yoink tx (0xb7882cc1, block 15655307) whose attacker origin was not established; this row's tx alone is 29.3065 WETH.
evidence_notes: 21 of 21 router calls (selector 0x006de4df on 0xc8d7899f) in Yoink's tx and the attacker's reverted tx have the same length (1864 hex chars) and, after swapping the recipient 0x75f2aba6 -> 0x6c6b87d4, differ only in words [26, 27] (the trailing amount field; incidents/transitswap-2022/call_diff.json says it is zero in the attacker's trace because the victim balances were already gone, and the victim's UNI balance in Yoink's); recomputed from site/raw/rpc/trace_<tx>.json, see incidents/transitswap-2022/call_diff.json.

Block 15655281: Yoink index 24, tip 3.000000002 gwei (effective 9.065325223 gwei); attacker index 43, tip 3.0 gwei (9.065325221); block order follows descending tip: the three 3.000000002-gwei txs sit at indexes 23-25, the 3.0-gwei tier follows (incidents/transitswap-2022/race_15655281.json).
The attacker's earlier eight Ethereum txs (blocks 15655118-15655247) all succeeded and were not front-run; Yoink's txs in blocks 15655000-15655400 touch the router only in 15655281 and 15655307.
Yoink took 5,974.52 UNI via the router and sold it for 29.3065 WETH in one tx; no coinbase payment, no relay bid history for the block.

Return: exactly 26.505 ETH on 2023-09-06T14:24:35Z (tx 0x074acda8) after offering 90% of profits on 2022-10-23 (tx 0x57a98ef2); the attacker's own 3,180 ETH return to Transit (about 2022-10-02) is separate.
